mapper.select: SELECT P.PLACE_NO ,TO_CHAR(P.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_DATE ,P.PLACE_NAME ,T.TYPE ,P.PHONE_NUMBER ,P.DEL_YN FROM PLACE P LEFT JOIN TYPE_DETAIL TD ON P.TYPE_DETAIL_NO = TD.TYPE_DETAIL_NO LEFT JOIN TYPE T ON TD.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO ORDER BY P.PLACE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
